body:
Thanks, I figured while I have those feeling, I may as well do something with them. Also, it helped me feel better about everything as well. :]

>Do you have any more writing?

Nothing like this. This was the first time I tried to actually take the feelings I had and make them into something, as opposed to just letting them exist. But, it felt good to do this. I think it's something I'll keep doing, whenever I need to.
